There are two 2-categories of perfect operator categories Opperf ⊆ Admperf defined by Barwick. The category ∗ is initial in both 2-categories and terminal in Admperf , while F is terminal in Opperf . The category O sits somewhere in between. It is an open problem to characterize all perfect operator categories that have all pullbacks, or whose class of monomorphisms is stable under pullbacks. Additionally, it is not known to us whether the opposite □op of any of the various flavors of categories of cubes, which are of great interest to both homotopy theorists and homotopy type theorists, is the Kleisli category associated to some perfect operator category. 4.3 Other Examples ▶ Example 4.9. Given an alphabet A, we can define the set of words A∗ over this alphabet, i.e., A∗ is the free monoid generated by A. The assignment L : Set Set A A∗ induces a polynomial monad on Set, and therefore (SetL , Repr(L)) is a structured display map category. Observe that the unit is also monomorphic. L is called the list monad by computer scientists. ▶ Example 4.10.
